VBO:0200918.summary: Tree hunting shaped the Mountain View Cur, a selected Mountain Cur strain developed by Mike and Marie Bloodgood. Their dogs worked raccoon and squirrel and earned night-hunt and squirrel-hunt titles. The program began in 1986; Mountain View Curs competed across seven states in the early 1990s.
VBO:0200918.shortDescription: A selected Mountain Cur strain with a tree-hunting history, including raccoon and squirrel competition work.
